test_title: PYST 2: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The matches are being shown live on Sports TV.

options.text: Sports TV is showing the matches live.
Sports TV may be showing the matches live.
Sports TV will be showing the matches live.
Sports TV can be showing the matches live.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Sports TV is showing the matches live.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the passive voice, the emphasis is on the matches being the recipient of the action, and Sports TV is mentioned as the platform where the matches are being shown.
 
• **Passive Voice Structure**: Subject + Helping Verb + Main Verb + Adverb + Prepositional Phrase__
 
• **Example**: 
 __
 
• *The novel is being read by the students.* (Passive)
 
• *The students are reading the novel.* (Active)
 
 
 
• In the active voice, the focus shifts to the doer of the action, which is Sports TV. Sports TV is actively showing the matches live.
 
• **Active Voice Structure**: Subject + Main Verb + Object+ Adverb__
 
• **Example**: 
 
 
• *The chef is preparing a delicious meal.* (Active)
 
• *A delicious meal is being prepared by the chef.* (Passive)
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
